judges: Challa Gunaranjan Civil Miscellaneous Appeal J.
trial_court: Principal Senior Civil Judge, Kakinada, East Godavari District, O.P.No.131 of 2004
case_name: Chollangi Varaha Narasimha Murthy vs Kommanapudi Deepthi Sirisha
facts_of_case: The wife filed for dissolution of marriage under Section 12(1)(c) of the Hindu Marriage Act and for declaration that the marriage was null, void and voidable. The same was decreed on 18.12.2007.

legal_principles.principle: A party's failure to prosecute an appeal can result in dismissal of the appeal.
legal_principles.held: In view of the above, the Civil Miscellaneous Appeals are dismissed for 'want of prosecution'.

legal_principles.principle: A party's failure to engage a counsel can result in the court issuing notice for the same.
legal_principles.held: Issue notice to the respondent to engage a counsel, in view of elevation of her counsel to the Bench.

outcome.final_order: The Civil Miscellaneous Appeals are dismissed for 'want of prosecution'. No order as to costs.

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for dissolution of marriage under Hindu Marriage Act
responding to an appeal against decree of divorce
advising on interim orders and decrees
